title.zh: 左乘单射：一般证明与删条件反例
title.en: Injectivity of left multiplication: proof and counterexamples

statement.zh: 在右单位律下，L_g = L_h 推出 g = h；群是此结果的特例。
statement.en: Under the right identity law, L_g = L_h implies g = h; groups are a specialization.

zh: 任意类型 G、二元运算及一个右单位 e
en: An arbitrary type G, a binary operation and a right identity e
Equality of the left multiplication maps

scope.zh: 一般右单位结构中的条件定理、群特例以及两个删条件反例。
scope.en: A conditional theorem for arbitrary right-unital structures, its group specialization and two counterexamples obtained by dropping assumptions.

zh: 完整 Cayley 定理的左乘双射、复合同态及像子群尚未在本登记中认证
HOL 与 Lean 的一般翻译正确性尚未证明
原文对应关系待独立人工复核
en: Bijectivity, the composition homomorphism and the image subgroup of the full Cayley theorem are outside this registration
A general correctness theorem for the HOL–Lean translation is not proved
Correspondence with the prose awaits independent human review

note.zh: 条件与结论的逐项对照见 README；机器检查不代替人工核对。
note.en: The README maps assumptions and conclusions explicitly; machine checking does not replace human review.

registrations.theoryRef: mcs-foundations/08-关系代数与结构.md#命题-88代数闭包

title.zh: 第 8.8 条：有限规则生成的代数闭包
title.en: Proposition 8.8: algebraic closure generated by finitary rules

statement.zh: c(X) = ⋃ₙ Fⁿ(X) 广延、单调、幂等，并由 X 的有限子集决定。
statement.en: c(X) = ⋃ₙ Fⁿ(X) is extensive, monotone, idempotent and determined by finite subsets of X.

zh: 规则仅使用有限的正向前提，允许零前提规则
底集与规则族可以无限
en: Rules use finite positive premises; empty premise sets are allowed
The carrier and the rule family may be infinite

scope.zh: 按定义 8.7 的逐阶段生成证明四条一般性质；没有预先假设闭包公理。
scope.en: The four general properties follow from the stage construction in Definition 8.7; closure axioms are not assumed.

zh: 本登记不证明完整 HOL 推理系统或网站规划器正确
不把个人掌握、遗忘或预算规划等同于演绎闭包
原文对应关系待独立人工复核
en: This registration does not establish correctness of the complete HOL calculus or the website planner
Personal mastery, forgetting and budgeted planning are not identified with deductive closure
Correspondence with the prose awaits independent human review

note.zh: Finset 表达有限前提，Set 表达任意底集与规则族；对应说明见 README。
note.en: Finset expresses finite premises and Set permits arbitrary carriers and rule families; see the README correspondence table.
